starter_questions: What does the BACE1 sample demonstrate?
Should I provide protein targets or a disease name?

setup_guide.introduction: I'll evaluate five distinct molecule candidates and explain their computational ranking for scientific review. Review the research profile and protein targets, or keep BACE1 and the synthetic seed inputs for a walkthrough. The sample uses the normal scientific pipeline; results do not establish experimental efficacy or safety.

sample.title: Computational discovery sample
sample.description: Use synthetic seed inputs for one computational cycle; the bundled default target is BACE1. Normal scientific preparation and hardware are still required.
sample.expected_output: Five distinct candidates with computational evaluations, ranking evidence and scientific limitations, not experimentally validated treatments.

real.introduction: Review the therapeutic profile, explicit protein targets and approved research folder. I’ll evaluate one five-candidate cycle and explain the computational ranking and missing validation.
